column1: # Commit map: pre-migration history -> GitHub baseline (2026-10-16)
# CS-PLAN-085 D-085-07. The identity rewrite changed every commit hash, so the
# qualification evidence recorded in older plans, review records and backlog
# archives (package smokes, browser gates, release candidates) names commits
# that no longer exist. This map resolves them.
# Produced by `git filter-repo` (.git/filter-repo/commit-map); SHA pairs only,
# no file content. A new hash of all zeros means the commit was dropped.
# Usage: grep the old short SHA, take the new hash.
